channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Son of slain filmmaker Rob Reiner pleads not guilty to murder charges
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> Nick Reiner, the troubled son of slain Hollywood filmmaker Rob Reiner, pleaded not guilty today to murder charges stemming from the fatal stabbing of his parents in their home, one of the most shocking celebrity homicide cases in Los Angeles history.

item.title: Former U.K. ambassador to U.S. arrested after Epstein revelations
item.description: LONDON >> Former British ambassador to the U.S. Peter Mandelson was arrested by London police today on suspicion of misconduct in public office, following revelations over his ties to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Supreme Court to weigh oil-industry effort to end major climate suit
item.description: The Supreme Court announced today that it had agreed to hear a major climate lawsuit in which the oil industry is claiming it shouldn’t be sued in state courts over its role in global warming. The outcome could have wide bearing on dozens of other lawsuits around the country.

item.title: Kaiser workers’ strike set to end Tuesday morning
item.description: The strike by thousands of health care workers at Kaiser Permanente in Hawaii and California is set to end on Tuesday.

item.title: Kash Patel defends Olympic locker room celebration in Italy
item.description: WASHINGTON >> FBI Director Kash Patel is defending his weekend beer-soaked locker-room celebration with the victorious U.S. men’s hockey team at the Winter Olympics in Milan, saying he had been in Italy on official business and would pay his own way for personal activities.

item.title: BBC apologizes for airing BAFTA racial slur made by guest with Tourette’s
item.description: LONDON >> The BBC apologized today for failing to edit out a racial slur from its broadcast of Britain’s top movie awards, after a guest with Tourette syndrome shouted out while two Black actors from the film “Sinners” were presenting an award.

item.title: Second travel-related dengue case of year identified on Oahu
item.description: The Hawaii Department of Health has identified a second travel-related dengue case this year, this time on Oahu.

item.title: Woman arrested after stabbings in Chinatown, downtown Honolulu
item.description: Honolulu police have arrested a 30-year-old woman this morning for allegedly stabbing two men — one at a bus stop in Chinatown and the other while on the bus heading down South King Street.

item.title: Dow Jones plunges 821 points amid AI and tariff fears
item.description: NEW YORK >> Wall Street stocks tumbled today, as ongoing fears of artificial intelligence-related disruption and the fallout from Friday’s U.S. Supreme Court ruling sent investors fleeing from high-risk equities.

item.title: Kauai teen in critical condition after 3-vehicle crash
item.description: A Kauai teen is in critical condition after a three-vehicle collision on Kaumualii Highway this morning.
